Most histories are short, so emphasizing nearby interactions may reduce sparse long-range mixing while retaining sufficient receptive field. Preserve features, embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer; synchronize the predictor architecture.

category_rationales.rationale: Use dilation schedule [1,2,4,1,2,4] across all four category models to emphasize nearby interactions in short histories while retaining both causal convolutions per block. The generated predictor imports this same model class, keeping training and inference consistent without changing checkpoint shapes, features, embeddings, readout, loss, or optimizer.
